_meta.description: Shell plc reporting business segments as defined in the Shell Annual Report / Form 20-F FY2024.

segments.name: Integrated Gas
segments.description: Liquefied natural gas (LNG), the conversion of natural gas into gas-to-liquids fuels and products, and the marketing and trading of LNG and natural gas. Shell is the world's largest LNG trader.

segments.name: Upstream
segments.description: Exploration for and extraction of crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids, plus the transport of these to market.

segments.name: Marketing
segments.description: Sale of fuels, lubricants and convenience retail to retail and business customers — the Mobility, Lubricants, and Sectors & Decarbonisation businesses.

segments.name: Chemicals & Products
segments.description: Refineries and chemical plants that turn crude oil and feedstocks into fuels and petrochemicals, plus associated pipeline, trading, optimisation and oil-sands activities.

segments.name: Renewables & Energy Solutions
segments.description: Renewable power generation; trading and optimisation of power and pipeline gas; carbon credits; hydrogen; carbon capture and storage; nature-based projects; and Shell Ventures.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.description: Non-operating support: holdings and treasury, headquarters and central functions, self-insurance, and centrally managed innovation.
